_comment: The FolioAssistant declaration for THIS instance — what directories it scans and what kind of graph each holds. See skills/folio-core/directory-conventions.md. This repo is PRE-SPLIT (issue #223), so it declares what is true today, not the target layout: `tools/`, `kg/` and `folio/` do not exist here yet and are deliberately not declared. A directory that is declared but absent is worse than one that is missing, because every consumer then scans nothing and reports a clean run over it.
